name: Goldcrown Tree
description: A colony timber tree whose crown turns gold in the cold season.
role: A second timber source with its own log, which gives crafting recipes a choice of wood.

artBrief.silhouette: Round crown on a short trunk, same mass as the rustbark.
artBrief.detail: Gold leaf clusters with amber shadow; darker brown trunk.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Gold #f6d32d and amber #e5a50a crown, dark browns #63452c and #865e3c trunk.
